title: Floating Teahouse Concept Design Brief Builder

variables.name: avoid
variables.default: neon signs, glass curtain walls, people in the frame, readable text

variables.name: must
variables.default: hipped cedar shingle roof, sliding paper shoji, narrow engawa deck, two stone lanterns on the dock, a small tied wooden boat

variables.name: scale
variables.default: intimate, seats 6 to 8 on floor cushions, ceremonial tea for small groups

variables.name: setting
variables.default: a quiet mountain lake in early autumn, forested shores, soft fog

variables.name: vibe
variables.default: Japanese-inspired cedar, not a theme-park copy; quiet, handmade, slightly weathered

variables.name: views
variables.default: morning approach from the shore path; dusk interior looking out across the water
